title: Georgia Coastal RV Park

services.name: Satilla River Fishing
services.desc: Cast into the bountiful Big Satilla River, just 8-minutes from GA Coastal RV Park-your ideal RV anchorage for a memorable fishing adventure. For the best fishing conditions, check the USGS gages for water levels between 4-8 feet at Waycross and 3-7 feet at Atkinson before heading out. Happy fishing, and we hope to see you at GA Coastal RV Park - your gateway to the Satilla River! Learn more about Satilla River Fishing here: Learn about fishing at the Big Satilla
